component.name: QBucket
component.summary: Browse and manage S3-compatible object storage

description.p: QBucket is a native desktop browser for Amazon S3 and S3-compatible object storage such as Hetzner Object Storage, Ceph RGW, Garage and others.

It is built for working with production data: every destructive operation is planned, previewed and verified, features the server does not support are detected automatically and cannot be triggered, and the interface stays responsive even with millions of objects.

ul.li: Uploads and downloads of any size: multipart, verified, resumable after a crash
Copy and move between buckets, drag and drop in and out of the file manager
Metadata, tags, access control, presigned links
Bucket policy, CORS, lifecycle rules and object lock
Open an object in another application and upload the changes
Secrets in the system keychain only

description.p: The first release, on par with the essentials of S3 Browser:

ul.li: Accounts for AWS S3, Hetzner, Ceph RGW, Garage and any S3-compatible endpoint, imported from the AWS CLI or rclone
Verified, resumable transfers of any size; copy, move, drag and drop
Metadata, tags, access, versions, bucket configuration and object lock
Every change planned, previewed, verified and journaled

description.p: Project skeleton: main window layout, light and dark theme.
